goal: Place report language in the Senate NDAA managers' package directing a fielding-status report for a soldier-borne power capability, and carry it into conference as a directive hook for a later funding request.

clientContextFixture.profileSummary: Small business with a qualified soldier-borne power unit and a documented unit shortfall; no funding increase is requested in this cycle, only directive report language; the Senate NDAA has not been taken up on the floor and a SASC-member sponsor has not yet been secured.

nodes.subject: optics
nodes.title: Managers' package excludes items without bipartisan staff clearance

nodes.subject: ask
nodes.title: Client input required: requirement or fielding gap and the program of record

nodes.subject: deliverable
nodes.title: Draft the report-language concept and one-page justification

nodes.subject: member
nodes.title: Secure a SASC-member sponsor office to carry the language

nodes.subject: ask
nodes.title: Sponsor office confirms it will file the language

nodes.subject: committee
nodes.title: Clear the language with SASC majority and minority staff

nodes.subject: submission
nodes.title: File the report-language amendment for the Senate NDAA managers' package

nodes.subject: outcome
nodes.title: Language included in the managers' package or carried to conference

nodes.subject: committee
nodes.title: Conference positioning with HASC and SASC staff

nodes.subject: outcome
nodes.title: Conference report carries the directive, or the FY28 request window opens

orderingAssertions.description: a sponsor is secured before the language is filed

notes: Report-language-only amendment (no dollars): the vehicle-named submission (n7) satisfies amendment-no-vehicle, and because no funding increase is requested the offset gate is NOT required; exercises the offset check's funding-ask guard. Senate track with conference and FY28 fallback.
